remarks: Welcome to 2160 Willow Wisp, a beautifully maintained, nearly new Lennar townhome in the sought-after "Parkvue community" at The Enclave in Upland. Built in 2023 and in excellent condition, this 3-bedroom, 3 bath home offers approximately 1,722 sq ft of light-filled living across three levels. Natural light pours through the open-concept main level, where upgraded luxury vinyl plank flooring flows throughout. Beautiful kitchen features a large island that is perfect for entertaining. This turnkey home also offers updated finishes with a cozy room ideal for a library.
